title: Audio: I2S out and in, PDM microphone
summary: Play sound through an I2S DAC or amplifier module (PCM5102A, MAX98357A), record from an I2S ADC, or from a digital PDM microphone with a CIC filter in hardware. 48.8 kHz stereo, 16 bit.
wiring: DAC module BCK, DIN, LCK (PCM5102A) or BCLK, DIN, LRC (MAX98357A)
PCM5102A: SCK pin to GND (it makes its own clock), FMT to GND
DAC / ADC modules that need a master clock
PDM microphone CLK / DATA (SEL to GND = left)
for example an SPH0641 or MP34DT01 board
MAX98357A also works at 5 V from an outside supply
parts: PCM5102A DAC board + headphones / amplifier, or a MAX98357A amplifier board + speaker
optional: PDM microphone board, I2S ADC board
tested: the self-test passed 5 of 5 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
